title: Verify Email Request
description: POST /api/v1/auth/verify-email body. Two shapes: {verification_token} (legacy token-only confirmation, for accounts registered without activation confirmation) and {verification_token, password} (activation confirmation, where the mailbox owner sets the password; password 1..128 characters). Accounts in a pending-activation state always require the password, even when the feature is off. `password` is optional in this schema so the token-only shape stays valid. The server rejects unknown properties: the legacy path with a 400 validation error, the activation path with the uniform ACTIVATION_FAILED response; the legacy path also rejects `password`. additionalProperties stays true here only because closing it would be a breaking change to this published schema.

verification_token.description: Email-verification token from the emailed link.

password.description: Password chosen by the mailbox owner. Required when activation confirmation is in effect.
